Management Consulting Analyst (Co-op)

Company: Westbrook Advisory Group
Location: Toronto, ON
Work Arrangement: Hybrid
Work Term: Fall 2027
Duration: 4 months
Salary: $29.00 per hour
Application Deadline: June 25, 2027

The Opportunity

Westbrook Advisory Group is a management consulting firm supporting public sector clients.
The analyst will contribute to client engagements across operations and strategy.

What You Will Do

- Conduct research and quantitative analysis for client engagements
- Prepare client-ready deliverables and presentation materials
- Support consultants throughout the engagement lifecycle

This is a four month work term.
